title: Tamsin and the Alibi
author: Gideon Villalobos
blurb: Paloma Sterling, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
